description: A personal AI assistant with web chat, session memory and optional Telegram and Discord channels.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a personal assistant with web chat and Telegram support
ui.description: Node.js gateway with WebSocket real-time chat, SQLite memory, optional Telegram/Discord adapters, and a web dashboard.

sample_prompts: A personal AI assistant with web chat, session memory, and Telegram integration
An AI gateway with a web dashboard, conversation logs, and Discord bot support
A multi-channel AI chatbot with web UI, memory, and optional WhatsApp adapter

user_inputs.label: Dashboard Admin Password
user_inputs.hint: Protects the web dashboard. Defaults to 'lobster' if not set.

user_inputs.label: Telegram Bot Token
user_inputs.hint: Get from @BotFather. Leave blank to disable Telegram.

user_inputs.label: Discord Bot Token
user_inputs.hint: Discord application bot token. Leave blank to disable Discord.

user_inputs.label: WhatsApp Access Token
user_inputs.hint: Permanent or temporary access token from Meta Developer portal. Leave blank to disable WhatsApp.

user_inputs.label: WhatsApp Phone Number ID
user_inputs.hint: Numeric ID from Meta → WhatsApp → API Setup (not the phone number itself).

user_inputs.label: WhatsApp Webhook Verify Token
user_inputs.hint: A string you choose; must match what you enter in Meta webhook configuration.

user_inputs.label: Signal API URL
user_inputs.hint: URL of your signal-cli-rest-api instance. Leave blank to disable Signal.

user_inputs.label: Signal Phone Number
user_inputs.hint: E.164 phone number registered with signal-cli-rest-api (e.g. +14155552671).

user_inputs.label: Signal Allowed Senders
user_inputs.hint: Comma-separated E.164 numbers allowed to chat. Leave blank to allow anyone.
